title: Memory Daemon
description: Use this when you need the sox graph-memory enrichment pipeline running: a singleton Unix-socket service that drains the batch-enrich queue and runs deterministic clustering, importance scoring, and auto-links via @sox/memory-enrich — zero LLM calls, no provider required.
author: sox-ecosystem
